facts.business: Padmanabh Alloys & Polymers Limited manufactures filled and reinforced thermoplastic compounds and master batches including mineral filled thermoplastic, mineral master batches, synthetic paper master batches, glass reinforced thermoplastic and other specialty masterbatches.

segments.name: Single segment (thermoplastic compounds and master batches)
